summary: A lightweight, Telegram-authenticated dating profile manager built as a functional MVP. It demonstrates secure passwordless authentication, stateless session management, and server-side rendered routing using FastAPI and SQLite.
key_features: Telegram Authentication with HMAC-SHA256 payload verification
JWT Session Management with 1-hour expiration and Bearer validation
Automatic SQLite user upsert on first login with profile redirection
Server-side HTML rendering via FastAPI + Jinja2
Auto-generated interactive API documentation (Swagger UI & ReDoc)
achievements: Implemented secure passwordless authentication by cryptographically verifying Telegram Login Widget payloads using HMAC-SHA256. Designed stateless session management with time-bound JWTs and Bearer token validation. Built an async-ready backend with clear separation of concerns, integrating SQLite persistence with Pydantic validation. Proactively identified and documented critical production readiness improvements, including SQL injection mitigation via parameterized queries, proper database ID generation, and secure routing context handling.
